outputs.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit target: the attached/referenced cg_root.png, exactly the existing 1600x900 opaque game CG. This is an extremely localized retouch, NOT a new illustration.
Primary request: replace EVERY floating white square target paper with a tall narrow OFF-WHITE paper talisman strip, approximately WIDTH:HEIGHT 1:3 in its own plane, with a faint warm ivory tint. Keep their current centres, perspective, density, size hierarchy, wind flow and depth. Some strips may curl or flutter. On EVERY strip, put just ONE abstract loose OPEN red brush swoosh/swirl at its middle and ONE short simple dark brush dash near its top. The red stroke must be irregular, open and brushlike, never closed concentric rings, targets, bullseyes or geometric symbols. The top mark is a single abstract brush dab, NOT lettering. Absolutely no readable writing, letters, numbers, kanji, runes or glyphs on any strip, even far away.
Invariants: preserve all pixels outside small local areas around the papers as exactly as possible. Keep root silhouette and bark details, all snow and icicles, aurora, cavern and ice structures, the broken cyan seal ring with its exact existing gaps and geometry, magenta light, all framing/composition and the dark bottom quarter unchanged. Do not move, crop, reframe, relight, recolor, sharpen or repaint the background. No added motifs or figures.
Output one edited image, opaque 1600x900, same detailed pixel-painted style.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: start_card_frame, transparent pixel-art 9-slice frame.
Input image 1 is the existing dialogue frame to adapt into a taller stage-start card; image 2 is the matching name plate, style reference only. Make one standalone EMPTY transparent frame in the same visual family, changing the aspect ratio to 8:5. Intended final canvas exactly 480x300 pixels, scalable to a 900x520 stage-start panel. Generate at 1440x900 or another exact 8:5 multiple if a larger canvas is needed.
Preserve the restrained original ornament language: a small angular gold leaf-wing scroll and faceted BLUE DIAMOND GEM at each of four corners. The four ornaments must stay entirely inside the 24x24 final-pixel corner squares (5% canvas width and 8% canvas height; 72x72 on a 1440x900 canvas). Keep them small and consistent with reference, not huge filigree. Between the four corners, perfectly plain straight double-line borders: outer gold line, thin inner blue line, dark navy outline. No decorative marks anywhere along the middle of edges. OMIT centre-top gem.
Palette precisely gold #f3cd7c, deep gold #a8742c, gem blue #3d7bd9, ice-blue highlight #9fd2ff, dark outline #101827. Crisp 1x pixel-art geometry, integer pixel steps, no gradients, blur, soft glow or antialiasing. Border wholly inside canvas with tiny empty outside corner pixels.
Centre MUST BE genuinely FULLY TRANSPARENT alpha, exterior also transparent. No background color or checkerboard painted into image. No lettering, no text, no sample contents, no icons apart from the corner gems, no logo, watermark, shadow or filled panel. Output one empty border asset only.
